items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the contribution notice
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: No separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the posting day equals the Bescheid date 18.11.2026 (Wed). A statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse) is a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting, and this delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend/holiday (unlike tax offices). 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sun) = deemed delivery day. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 22.12.2026 (Tue). 22.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.

items.title: First debit of the increased monthly contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The new monthly contribution of 318,46 € applies from 01.01.2027. The letter states contributions are debited on the 15th of the following month, so January 2027's contribution (the first at the new rate) is collected on 15.02.2027. That date (a Monday) is not a weekend or public holiday, so no shift is needed under § 193 BGB.
